scenes.title: Omelette and Silence
scenes.summary: Max cooks an omelette to make peace with Vika while she gives him the silent treatment, and Kostya arrives asking them to babysit Styopa on their day off.

scenes.title: The Copper Sauté Pan
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov fumes in the kitchen of Arcobaleno because his favorite French copper sauté pan is still back at Claude Monet, while Kostya hands Max supplies for Styopa.

scenes.title: Forgotten Fruit
scenes.summary: Kostya realizes he forgot to bring Styopa's fruit and asks Max to lie to Nastya for him, right before lecturing Max on why husbands should always tell their wives the truth.

scenes.title: Practice for a Dad
scenes.summary: Calm little Styopa immediately breaks something in the apartment, and when German calls Vika into Claude Monet over a theft, Vika leaves Max alone to babysit.

scenes.title: Crime of the Century
scenes.summary: Vika rushes to Claude Monet expecting a major burglary, only to discover that German called her and the police because Chef Barinov took his copper sauté pan.

scenes.title: The Police Report and the Sturgeon
scenes.summary: A police officer arrives at Claude Monet to take German's theft report for the sauté pan, and Senya tries to blame his own pilfered sturgeon on the robbery.

scenes.title: Conversation Over
scenes.summary: German marches into Arcobaleno to demand the copper sauté pan back from Chef Barinov, threatening him with police trouble, while Kostya phones Max to check on Styopa.

scenes.title: The Sauté Pan in the Safe
scenes.summary: German locks the reclaimed copper sauté pan inside an old office safe to keep Barinov away from it, and Vika slyly asks to borrow the spare keys.

scenes.title: The Heist Plan
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov recruits Senya, Fedya, and Louis in the courtyard, promising them a trip to the banya if they drug German with sleeping drops and steal the safe keys.

scenes.title: The Wrong Boy
scenes.summary: While walking in the park, Max gets a call from Kostya that Nastya's father is coming to pick up Styopa, and Max accidentally hands over the wrong boy in a Spider-Man mask.

scenes.title: Coffee with Sleeping Drops
scenes.summary: Louis serves German a cup of coffee laced with sleeping drops, and once German passes out on his desk, Senya and Fedya play games to decide who has to search his pockets.

scenes.title: Magnetic Storms
scenes.summary: German wakes up from his drugged nap convinced that strong magnetic storms made him faint, while Max realizes the boy in his apartment is Roma and rushes to the police.

scenes.title: In the Walk-In Fridge
scenes.summary: At the police station, Roma's mother spots her son with Max and accuses him of kidnapping, while back at Claude Monet the cooks lock German inside the walk-in cooler.

scenes.title: The Heavy Safe
scenes.summary: With German locked in the cooler, Chef Barinov discovers that neither stolen key fits the safe, so he orders Senya and Fedya to push the entire safe out the window.

scenes.title: The Swap and the Drop
scenes.summary: At the police station, Nastya's father refuses to believe he has the wrong child until he pulls off the mask, while back at Claude Monet the safe crushes German's car.

scenes.title: Man to Man
scenes.summary: After Max safely returns Styopa to Kostya, German discovers his crushed car in the courtyard and challenges Chef Barinov, Senya, and Fedya to settle the score with their fists.

scenes.title: Friendly Sparring
scenes.summary: After German easily knocks down Barinov, Senya, and Fedya, a police officer arrives and both chefs pretend they are simply colleagues boxing on their break.

scenes.title: Two Sauté Pans
scenes.summary: Elena reveals she already unlocked German's safe with Vika's spare key and swapped Barinov's copper pan for a new one, and Barinov takes his bruised crew to the banya.

scenes.title: A Promise to Tell the Truth
scenes.summary: Back home, Vika admits she is impressed that Max managed a toddler all day without incident, and Max apologizes for lying about Denis and promises to always try to be honest.
